shared_elements: tall upright slab carved in low relief
content organised into stacked horizontal registers/bands
a row of repeated similar motifs across the top band
small profile heads/creature forms within compartments
justification: Both are tall upright surfaces whose carved content is organised into stacked horizontal registers, with a band of repeated similar units across the top, and both use shallow rounded relief with profile head-like forms; that is about as far as the correspondence goes. A shows densely packed rectangular sign-blocks of abstract, compartmented ornament with no recognisable scene, while B shows discrete large animals (long-necked bird, snake, quadruped, raptor-like bird) placed freely on an open field with a zigzag/net band — different subject matter and quite different figure-to-ground conventions.
